No JS errors. All required data-testids confirmed in code: lousa-subtab-board, lousa-subtab-central_ont, central-ont-panel, central-ont-block-toggle, central-ont-threshold, central-ont-row-{id}, auth-req-{id}, auth-req-{id}-approve, auth-req-{id}-reject, finalize-bad-signal-warning, finalize-sn-mismatch-warning, bad-signal-auth-wait-modal.

minor.issue: SN mismatch detection re-runs enrich_tickets_with_live_signal on EVERY finalize (HTTP call to SmartOLT). Adds latency to the technician's close action. Consider only running it when cd.ont differs from already-stored live_signal.sn.

Uses 'closed_by' first then falls back to 'assigned_collaborator_id' for grouping — works but if a gestor admin-closed a ticket the bad-signal would be attributed to the admin user (not a technician). Document or filter by role.

ui_bugs.issue: Threshold hardcoded as < -27 in JSX (line 855) instead of using the company's configured bad_signal_threshold from /central-ont/settings. If admin sets threshold to e.g. -25 or -30, the technician's yellow warning will still trigger only at -27. Backend block uses configured threshold correctly — this is a UI-only inconsistency.

integration_issues.flow: SN mismatch warning on technician finalize
integration_issues.issue: Frontend SN-mismatch check at line 867 reads ticket.live_signal?.sn — this requires the technician's ticket-fetch endpoint to pre-enrich live_signal. Confirm the public/mobile ticket endpoints call enrich_tickets_with_live_signal before returning; otherwise the inline warning will never fire (backend will still detect mismatch at finalize time and store sn_mismatch on the ticket).

critical_code_review_comments: routes/lousa.py public_finalize_ticket — clean separation of (a) bad-signal validation, (b) SN-mismatch detection, (c) ticket update, (d) notifications. No issues.
routes/lousa.py L1186-1190 — central_ont_settings lookup with default fallback is correct; threshold -27.0 default matches PRD.
routes/lousa.py L1268-1284 — SN-mismatch try/except swallows ALL exceptions silently; recommend logging at debug level to avoid silent failures during SmartOLT outages.

routes/lousa.py L1198-1210 — auth request doc uses uuid.uuid4().hex[:10] for id (bsa-xxxxxxxxxx). 10 hex chars = 40 bits which is fine for low-volume but consider full uuid for uniqueness if blast-radius grows.
frontend/src/lousa/CentralOntPanel.js — well-structured component (~430 lines). Auth-request approval/reject inline in the same panel is great UX.
frontend/src/LousaMobile.js — BadSignalAuthWaitModal with 4s polling is a sensible default; consider exponential backoff if approval takes >2 min.
